item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible evidence that Putin in 2023 launched or sustained a serious anti-corruption, anti-monopoly, or anti-oligarch capture campaign. The strongest pro-side material is limited to technocrats resisting arbitrary seizures and warning against harmful fiscal choices. The overall pattern is still loyalty-based control, selective expropriation, and politicized business privilege.","evidence":[{"title":"Putin tells Russia's billionaires to put patriotism before profit","publisher":"Reuters","date":"16 Mar 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/putin-urges-russias-billionaires-to-invest-in-face-of-sanctions-war-3032372","summary":"Strong negative evidence: Putin told business elites their role was to support society and the state, not just make money.
